messages:
Eleanor S: Customer opened a ticket — streaming JSON mode returns well-formed chunks but the final object is frequently missing trailing braces. Parser throws SyntaxError: Unexpected end of JSON input. Happens only when requests go through customer's edge proxy (ld-proxy). They see a clean stream in our logs but client-side shows truncated tail.

Mohit S: Which endpoint, content-type and sample request? Any repro curl we can run? Also paste the raw stream bytes if possible.

Eleanor S: Endpoint: POST /v1/generate?mode=structured JSON. They use chunked transfer + SSE style events. Minimal repro curl we got from them: ```curl -N -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -H 'Accept: text/event-stream' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"prompt":"emit json array","stream":true}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate```

Jamie L: Customer sent a recorded client capture. Raw stream fragment they get (each line is an SSE ‘data:’ payload):
```
data: {"id":1,"choices":[{"delta":{"content":"{\"items\":[1,2,3"}}]}
data: {"id":1,"choices":[{"delta":{"content":",4,5]"}}]}
data: {"id":1,"choices":[{"delta":{"content":"}\n"}}]}
```
But often the last line is missing the final `}` or it arrives as an empty string.

Alex R: On past incidents this looks like an early FIN from an intermediate proxy or a connection reset during the final TCP flush. Two quick checks: 1) can the customer disable proxy buffering (chunk aggregation) or increase keepalive/idle time, 2) can they try a raw TCP capture to confirm socket FIN timing?

Mohit S: Also ask customer to enable `Transfer-Encoding: chunked` logging and send us the exact chunked boundaries. If the final chunk size is 0 but proxy closes before sending it, client will get truncated payload.

Eleanor S: Customer tried toggling gzip and saw reduced frequency when gzip was off — suggests proxy may buffer and close on upstream timeouts. They agreed to run a controlled test with tcpdump and to send us the pcap.

Jamie L: For immediate mitigation recommend server-side fallback: emit an explicit final SSE data: event like `data: {"__end__":true}` before closing the stream so client can treat missing brace as end-marker. Not perfect but buys time.

Support Bot: Incident created: INC-2026-3474. Assign to eng-runtime for deeper tracing.

Alex R: I'll pick this up — will correlate our socket logs and look for midstream FINs, also check NGINX/ld-proxy timeout settings we've seen in other accounts.

Eleanor S: Thanks — forwarding customer's pcap as soon as they upload it. :pray:
